question.text: Where a REIT invests in real estate indirectly rather than directly, through which entity does it make the investment?

answer.text: Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) in which the REIT holds a controlling interest

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook page 277, REIT investment is made in real estate properties either directly or through a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) in which the REIT holds a controlling interest. The SPV is the indirect-route entity referenced in the source. The Trap: AMC and Trustee Company are roles borrowed from mutual fund and trust structures and do not act as the investment-holding vehicle for REIT assets. "Holding Company" is a generic term not used in the workbook for this purpose. Note: The source allows both direct holding and SPV-based holding; the SPV is the answer specifically when the question concerns the indirect investment route.
